name: n8n
summary: Visual workflow automation you can self-host with unlimited runs. Strong AI/agent nodes.
gains: Unlimited workflows and executions when self-hosted
400+ integrations plus any API via HTTP node
tradeoffs: Not OSI open source (fair-code license; free for your own use)
You keep the server running and updated
setupSteps: Rent a small server (shared with your other self-hosted apps)
Run n8n with Docker using the official docker-compose guide
Open n8n, create your owner account
Rebuild your most important Zap first, test it, then move the rest
